text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article focused primarily on quantifying and valuing carbon sequestration and storage in UK coastal habitats. Although it includes historical data and future projections (1900–2060) of habitat area changes and associated carbon sequestration capacity, it does not conduct spatially explicit land use/land cover (LULC) prediction or simulation with mapped outputs. The study does not implement ≥2 future spatial LULC scenarios with quantitative spatial accuracy metrics or provide mapped LULC projections. Instead, it uses literature-based area change estimates and applies carbon valuation. The focus is on ecosystem service valuation rather than LULC modeling or prediction. Therefore, it fails core inclusion criteria related to spatial LULC prediction modeling and outputs.)
